item.title: A Brief Exploration of Variational Autoencoder (VAE) with Code Implementation
item.description: Learning variational autoencoder (VAE) by reading and analyzing the paper: “Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes”. This post will introduce the basic work of VAE, including the derivation of formulas and simple code verification.
